headline: Central Bank of Liberia and Judiciary Strengthen Capacity on New Banking Law
summary: The Central Bank of Liberia, in collaboration with the James A. A. Pierre Judicial Institute and the UNDP, concluded a training program to strengthen judges' capacity to interpret and apply the new Banking and Financial Institutions Act.
why: Judicial training on updated banking legislation ensures consistent enforcement of financial regulations and strengthens institutional credit risk resolution frameworks.

impacts.name: Liberia
impacts.why: Improved legal enforcement of banking acts reinforces financial sector stability.
